name: ingest_drive_resume
description: Pull a resume (PDF or Google Doc) from Google Drive by file_id, save it under /candidates/<id>/resume.<ext>, and update the candidate row with a resume_path pointer. When the founder receives a resume via email/DM/Drive share, they paste the Drive link into the operator app and this function brings the file into the pod's own storage so it's part of the durable candidate record.
